about: Howard S. Suskin is a top-rated attorney selected to Super Lawyers for 2006 - 2027. He works at Jenner & Block LLP, located in Chicago, Illinois, and provides legal services for issues involving Securities Litigation, Class Action / Mass Torts: Defense and Alternative Dispute Resolution to the surrounding community.
Howard Suskin completed legal studies at The University of Michigan Law School and graduated with the class of 1983. Howard Suskin passed the bar in 1983.

Only a few attorneys from each state are selected to Super Lawyers designation for any given year. The multi-factor selection process includes independent research, peer nominations and evaluations, as well as professional achievement in legal practice.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
